title: Holding More Than One Crestline Seat and Bag Subscription
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold at most 2 Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions products at a time, and only when one covers bags and the other covers seats; the holding-overlap rule of the Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions governs which pairs are allowed.

The limit has two parts, and both hold together: a count (no more than 2 at a time) and a composition (when there are 2, one covers bags and the other covers seats).

## Desk training questions

**Q. What is the most subscriptions a customer may hold at a time?**
Two. A customer may not hold a third subscription at the same time.

**Q. If a customer holds exactly 2, what must be true of them?**
One of the two covers bags and the other covers seats. Two subscriptions that do not split that way are not a permitted holding of 2.

**Q. Which particular pairs meet that description?**
That is decided by the holding-overlap rule of the Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions, which governs which pairs are allowed.

## Count at a glance (hypothetical holdings)

| Subscriptions held at the same time | Within this rule |
|---|---|
| 1 | Yes |
| 2, one covering bags and the other covering seats | Yes, subject to the holding-overlap rule on which pairs are allowed |
| 2 that do not split into one covering bags and one covering seats | No |
| 3 or more | No |
